text_markup: The Runner has installed programs with total memory cost equal to their memory limit when the Corp plays {card:Bad Times}, reducing the memory limit by 2[MU]. The Runner can trash any two programs with a memory cost of 1[MU] each, or any one program with a memory cost of 2[MU] or greater. They cannot trash any 0[MU] programs, nor can they trash any set of more than one program with a greater total memory cost than 2[MU], since those objects can be removed from the trashed set while maintaining that the result will be a legal game state.
